title: 4400 PSI, 4.2 GPM, 13 HP (420cc) Commercial Duty Pressure Washer EPA
description:
OVERVIEW
The PREDATOR Commercial Duty Pressure Washer delivers 4400 PSI and 4.2 GPM for unbeatable cleaning power. The professional-grade Annovi Reverberi triplex pump has ceramic coated pistons for exceptionally long performance life. Five high-pressure quick connect tips and a 50 ft. steel reinforced high pressure hose give you plenty of range for wide area cleaning.
Professional-grade Annovi Reverberi triplex pump with brass manifold and ceramic coated pistons for exceptional life
Variable pressure control for the widest range of applications – from light surface cleaning to heavy paint stripping
420cc PREDATOR OHV gas engine with low oil shutdown
50 ft. heavy duty steel reinforced high-pressure hose
Five color-coded quick-connect spray tips
12 in. oversized flat-free tires handle the most rugged terrain
2x more cleaning power*
